title: Oracle request
description: One line of conformance/oracle/requests/<component>.jsonl (bun run oracle:extract, Story 3.1) or conformance/oracle-requests/<story-id>.jsonl (Story 3.4). The keys are exactly id, kind, input and sha256, in that order. sha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical JSON of {id, kind, input}: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit at every depth, no whitespace, '/' and non-ASCII unescaped. PHP source strings in setup and exprs are Upstream's verbatim token text with class names resolved to fully qualified \Names. Evaluation (Story 3.2): the Oracle instantiates the Test ID's Upstream test class, runs its setUp(), assigns each bindings entry (PHP literal source) to its variable, runs setup then evaluates exprs in order inside a closure bound to that instance, records each expr's value (or the exception class and message), and runs tearDown().

id.description: A PHPUnit Test ID (<FQCN>::<method>[#<dataset>]), a Pest Test ID (<suite>/tests/<file>::<description>[#<dataset>]) or an Xaravel Test ID (XT-<component>-<n>).

kind.description: Which evaluation the Oracle runs; it fixes the shape of input.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {id, kind, input}.

php-source.description: PHP source: a statement (with its ';') in setup, an expression (without one) in exprs.

setup.description: Statements run in order before exprs, in the closure bound to the Upstream test instance.

exprs.description: Expressions evaluated in order after setup; the Oracle records each value, in order.

object.description: A PHP array with string keys, as a JSON object in PHP order (an empty PHP array is {}).

php-expr.description: Str and other pure PHP expressions. bindings maps each data-provider parameter name (no $) to its dataset value as PHP literal source (lister.php export()), assigned before setup runs.

sql-grammar.description: SQL produced by a query or schema grammar. grammar names the builder helper (getBuilder base, get<SQLite|Postgres|MySql|MariaDb|SqlServer>Builder) or the schema grammar test file the setup uses; setup and exprs run as for php-expr.

blade-render.description: A Blade template the Oracle renders with \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade::render(template, data) in an Orchestra Testbench application, recording the HTML or the exception class and message (DIV-5's rendered-HTML expected values).

validation-message.description: Validator messages. The Oracle runs, bound to the test instance: $trans = $this->getIlluminateArrayTranslator(); $trans->addLines(lines, 'en'); $v = new \Illuminate\Validation\Validator($trans, data, rules, messages, attributes); then $v->messages()->setFormat(format) when format is not null; then evaluates exprs (which use $v) in order.

date-format.description: Date formatting under a frozen clock. now is the PHP source of the setTestNow argument the test class's setUp() passes (null when it sets none); setUp() itself applies it. timezone is the date.timezone the run uses (phpunit.xml.dist). setup and exprs run as for php-expr.
